issues.issue: Whether the RPD breached natural justice or procedural fairness by lacking compassion
issues.applicant_position: RPD lacked compassion for a woman claimant, breaching natural justice and the Guidelines.
issues.result_text: RPD did not breach natural justice or procedural fairness; questioning was not lacking in compassion.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in its credibility assessment, including its focus on contradictions and details
issues.applicant_position: RPD overemphasized contradictions and unimportant details affecting her credibility.
issues.result_text: Some details unimportant, but major contradictions rebut the presumption; credibility finding is well founded.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD properly considered documentary evidence on sexual violence against women
issues.applicant_position: RPD ignored documentary evidence on sexual violence against women and widows in Congo.
issues.result_text: RPD should have considered such evidence, but it does not establish serious risk to all women or widows.

issues.issue: Whether the appellant's profile as a woman exposes her to risk if returned
issues.applicant_position: Risk based on her profile as a woman should have been assessed; RPD did not do so.
issues.result_text: No documentary evidence establishes that her profile as a woman exposes her to serious risk.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD analysed only section 96 and not section 97
issues.applicant_position: RPD analysed only s.96 of the Act, not s.97.
issues.result_text: Credibility analysis is relevant to both refugee and protection status; denial is justified.
